sourceFindings: capabilityBusinessStatus guards can return NEEDS_ATTENTION before otherwise ready/retired readiness; READY also requires confirmed publication.state ONLINE and no UPDATE_AVAILABLE.

Cloud operations reject ERR_MED_00032; NAS delegates Local and reports SHARED_FILESYSTEM, not a native NAS/failover guarantee.
Missing reference lookup returns false, and physical purge does not atomically recheck all live owner references; retained/versioned physical cleanup is guarded.

It explains supported operations, stable replay identity, process-local and repository/provider non-atomic limits, exact refund status mapping, original Loyalty capture restriction and optional reconciliation persistence. Missing settlement/polling/reconciliation completion behavior is stated rather than implied.
sourceFindings: Card prepare accepts opaque tok_ descriptors; offline Stripe simulation does not call a gateway. Provider package names do not establish integration.
execute uses tenant:key in-flight dedupe and sequential repository find -> adapter execution -> record; no multi-worker exactly-once guarantee follows.
Only REFUND_DELAYED/REFUND_FAILED/REFUND_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED set reconciliationRequired; unknown adapter statuses are not automatically normalized safely.
Reconciliation is ACTION_REQUIRED or PENDING_PROVIDER_CONFIRMATION and may not be saved if the generated service is absent; the inspected services do not supply a settlement worker.
refundOrder currently requires matching original Loyalty capture/total/currency and uses a stable full-refund identity; it is not general partial-card refund execution.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: Readiness declaration validation is not independent live certification, signed-callback execution or production traffic approval evidence.
